name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* A full-site pull now brings down theme and plugin folders that are links to another folder (a Git checkout, the way a development site is often set up), leaving out their Git history and build tools. Before, those were left out and the pulled site had no theme.
* A full-site pull now lists anything it had to leave out, instead of leaving it out without a word.
